messages:
Marta: heads-up — quick async check on the optimize toolkit delivery. milestone still ETA end of week?
Sam: ETA is still Friday EOD from my side. final quant recommendations are in review, waiting on a perf sign-off from infra.
Devin: bump — I pushed a tiny change to the quant recs doc (reduced 8-bit fallback for long-context). link: https://go/recs/optkit
Lia: noted. who owns the KV cache integration ticket? I thought that was Tay but I can't find the PR.
Tay: I have the cache integration — PR #427 is open but blocked on eng-runtime review. @Sam can you flag the reviewers?
Sam: pinging runtime reviewers now. @Devin can you attach a short perf blurb to the PR so they can triage faster?
Devin: added a short summary and the benchmark snippet:
```
# benchmark snippet
python bench.py --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --quant int8
# median latency: 78ms/token (batching + kv cache enabled)
```
Marta: also: we saw one regression alert from the canary yesterday — small increase in tail latency when cache misses hit. not critical but we need ownership/mitigation plan.
Tay: that was me watching that run. root cause seemed to be async cache warmup + a bad batching boundary. I have a tentative fix in a branch `cache/warmup-fix`.
Sam: can you open a short issue with steps to reproduce and label it `regression:optkit`? we'll route to SRE if it looks infra-y.
Tay: done — https://go/issue/2389. added repro steps, logs snippet, and the branch. cc @Lia for KV semantics.
Lia: I'll review the branch tomorrow morning. if it's small we can fast-track to a canary rollback policy or deploy fix behind a flag.
Marta: ownership question: if Lia approves and Tay merges, who runs the canary and monitors for 1hr? I can take the first 30m but need someone to own the second half.
Sam: I can take the second 30m. I'll also run the smoke tests for embeddings and generation routes.
Marta: perfect. final checklist before Friday deploy:
- quant recs doc approved (Devin + Sam) : in-progress
- KV cache PR reviewed and merged (Tay + Lia) : in-review
- regression issue triaged and fix merged or rollback plan (Tay/Lia/Sam) : in-progress
- deploy plan and canary windows scheduled (Marta/Sam) : pending
Devin: quick question — any constraints on model variants for the rollout? e.g., should we pin to v1.2 quantized only for Dedicated customers?
Sam: good call. we'll pin hosted to v1.1 conservative quant for 24h, Dedicated can opt-in to v1.2. add to the deploy plan.
Marta: I'll update the deploy doc and post the canary schedule in #eng-oncall. ping here if anything blocks.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for optkit on 1715570000 (Fri 09:00-10:00 UTC). channel #eng-oncall will get alerts.
Tay: thanks — filing a short PR now to add the feature-flag gating so we can toggle if needed.
Marta: awesome. if nobody objects, I'll close this async checkin — keep pings here for any last-minute blockers :thumbsup:
Sam: all good from me.
Lia: good to go.
Devin: LGTM
